## Fixes

- The sidebar's **New note** button now uses the same theme colors and hover
  state as the start page's New note button, including its icon and shortcut.
- The bottom-right corner shows the **running app version**, linked to the
  latest Labradorite release on GitHub. It stays visible on the start page
  and while writing, including on phones.
- The sidebar search shortcut spells out **Shift** instead of using the
  unexplained arrow symbol: Ctrl Shift E (⌘ Shift E on macOS).

## Upgrading

Stop the previous Labradorite process and replace the binary. Your vault and
settings carry over.

## Downloads

One archive for **Linux amd64** includes the app and documentation. Verify it
against `SHA256SUMS`.

[Full changelog: v0.8.0 → v0.8.1](https://github.com/eg36/Labradorite/compare/v0.8.0...v0.8.1)
